en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of a large European city square with tram tracks, pedestrians, and classical stone buildings. A canal or basin crosses the right side of the square, bordered by railings. In the center distance is a prominent neoclassical building with arched windows and columns, and around the square are several multi‑story buildings. The image has printed captions in Swedish at the bottom identifying the place and publisher.
